idea-plugin.name: Markdown RTL
idea-plugin.description:
Persian & Right-to-Left (RTL) Markdown Enhancer

Automatically enhances Markdown preview with full RTL direction and Persian typography in IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio.

Features:

  • Automatic Preview Integration: Sits directly on the built-in Markdown preview window without needing any manual commands.
  • Direction Modes: Auto RTL (BiDi detection per paragraph/element), Force RTL, and Force LTR.
  • Code Block Protection: Ensures code snippets, pre, and inline code remain LTR with monospace typography.
  • Persian Typography: Bundled high-legibility Vazirmatn font (Regular & Bold), customizable font stack, font size, and line-height.
  • Headings & Lists: Tailored line height, right-aligned lists, and Persian-friendly quote borders.
  • Quick Toggle: Fast switching between direction modes via Toolbar, Context Menu, Tools menu, or shortcut (Shift+Alt+R).

action.description: Cycles Markdown preview between Auto-RTL, Force RTL, and Force LTR
